change.summary: Reject a 0xCF frame whose declared payload exceeds 1194 bytes before calling the blocking receive helper; reserve one byte after the five-byte header for the trailing frame byte.
change.stock_difference: The locked stock callback forwards oversized 16-bit lengths to blocking receive. This source-only guard intentionally changes that behavior to prevent writes past the 1200-byte frame buffer.

differential_emulation.inputs: Authenticated stock CASE raw image and freshly linked source CASE raw image
differential_emulation.controlled_lowers: Frame callback: bind, blocking receive, DE probe, event signal, and resync. Blocking receive: tick and UART wait. UART wait: tick. The same lower returns and memory effects were supplied to each image.
differential_emulation.compared_state: Return code where applicable, lower call order and arguments, frame count and bytes, UART handle fields, peripheral registers, PRIMASK, and receive buffer bytes.

capacity_boundary.length_1194: Stock and source both called blocking receive; source frame count became 1199 before the trailing byte.
capacity_boundary.length_1195: Stock called blocking receive; source called resync and bind without blocking receive.
capacity_boundary.length_65535: Stock called blocking receive; source called resync and bind without blocking receive.
